material_type.evidence: inferred: Here, we reconstituted in vitro the individual and collective activities of the ciliary tip module proteins, CEP104, CSPP1, TOGARAM1, ARMC9 and CCDC66, which interact with each other and with microtubules, and, when mutated, cause ciliopathies such as Joubert syndrome.
